collection.title: Mercedes-Benz Vito 2006 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Mercedes-Benz Vito Van 2006 to 2010 (639) requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 26" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
